title: Automated Media Exchange Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload custom labware definition, if needed.
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Prepare deck and equipment
steps.instruction: Place an empty reservoir for liquid waste, a 12‑channel reservoir containing the media to be added, tip racks, and any required Eppendorf plate(s) on the deck, and attach the P300‑Multi‑Channel pipette to the left mount. Load up to four plates for processing.

steps.title: Upload protocol bundle
steps.instruction: Download the protocol bundle from the Opentrons site and have it ready for upload.

steps.title: Upload custom labware definition
steps.instruction: If your labware is not already defined, upload a custom labware definition file to the OT App.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the prepared protocol file into the Opentrons OT‑2 App.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map, ensuring all labware and reservoirs are in the correct slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the OT App to calibrate the tip racks, reservoirs, plates, and the P300‑Multi‑Channel pipette.

steps.title: Perform media exchange per plate
steps.instruction: For each plate (up to four), execute the following actions:

substeps.instruction: Remove 120 µL of existing media from each well.
Add 140 µL of differentiation media to each well.
If a second exchange is selected (yes), then:
Remove 140 µL of differentiation media from each well.
Add 140 µL of fresh differentiation media to each well.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 App to start the automated media exchange.
